Hello poets and poetry lovers!

As those of you who've been digging deep into the sub already know we have a bit of poetry reading (as in audio recording) going on recently! @onomatopoeia is currently heading the initiative but others have been talking about joining her as well.

So the question I pose to our little community today is: what is the best Voat workflow we could establish for this type of thing, especially considering "reading requests", so someone can ask for a recording to be made?

We have though about using tags like [reading] or [reading request] for example. Or should we have a big "reading requests" sticky post for each month? Maybe an entirely new sub for requests and/or readings?

Anyway this is a very open-ended question so feel free to offer your own thoughts on the matter! Readings have been a really nice surprise for us and it helps shoot v/shortpoems to a whole new level as a way to bring the whole community together :)

And of course: if you feel like you'd like to give a shot at recording poems yourself you're absolutely welcome to join in the effort!

What I think what would be better for readers would be for the poem's text to be posted in the sub (as a text or link post) and then for the recordings to be posted as comments with links to the audio.

The problem with that though is that it would be kind of hard for the recorders to find requests. They'd have to explore the comments section and it would be easy to not come back and see requests that are made later on.

Another idea I'm having right now is that we could have a big sticky post with the names of all people interested in reading poems - this way it would be an easy reference if someone wants to make a request, just copy-paste all the @ names from the sticky into a comment or something like that.
